purpose: Teach: 縮減/教示/貸し付け/取り付ける/通帳/差し止め/持ち株/引き下げる

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、地域の犯罪を縮減する活動を継続します
lines.en: We will continue our efforts to reduce crime in the community.
lines.style: Measured official tone. Clear, steady delivery without theatricality. Slight pause after 'will' to signal commitment. Professional bearing in every syllable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、市民にも対策をご教示頂きありがたいです
lines.en: Yes. We're grateful for the guidance the police are providing to residents on these measures.
lines.style: Respectful and earnest. Slight nod in the voice on 'grateful.' Warm but formal—the tone of someone receiving information that matters. Not obsequious, just present.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、不正貸し付け業者を摘発します
lines.en: The police will crack down on illegal lending operations.
lines.style: Firm and factual. Weight on 'crack down'—this is serious work. No hesitation. Voice level stays steady. The tone of someone stating what will happen.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、防犯カメラを取り付ける助成事業ですね
lines.en: Yes. That's the subsidy program for installing security cameras, correct?
lines.style: Confirming, engaged. Slight lift at the end—genuine question seeking alignment, not challenging. Warm and collaborative in register. Shows he's listening and understanding.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪収益の通帳を捜査します
lines.en: The police will investigate criminal asset accounts.
lines.style: Steady procedural tone. Each word carries equal weight. No drama. The voice of someone laying out the facts of what the work entails. Composed and clear.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、違法薬物の差し止めを行いますね
lines.en: Yes. So the police are also working to stop the distribution of illegal drugs.
lines.style: Confirming understanding with quiet respect. Soft acknowledgment on 'yes.' Slight lean forward in tone—showing engagement without overstepping. Still warm and aligned.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、企業の持ち株偽装の捜査も進めます
lines.en: The police are also advancing the investigation into fraudulent share transfers at corporations.
lines.style: Formal and precise. Deliberate pacing. The tone shifts slightly—this is complex financial crime. Still even-keeled, but the words themselves demand attention. Professional but not cold.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、賄賂を引き下げる啓発活動、ありがたいです
lines.en: Yes. We're truly grateful for the police's awareness campaign to reduce bribery.
lines.style: Warm and sincere gratitude. Slight softening on 'truly grateful'—this is the end of a serious conversation and he's expressing genuine thanks. Still respectful but with visible relief that they're aligned.
